tools.name: A company's profile and funding
tools.description: One recently funded startup's profile and venture funding, when Fireround holds it: its headquarters (location), its sector, what the company does, its total raised (announced and reported rounds), its valuation (latest and every stated one), every round newest first with its leads and official announcement, and every investor on them, leads first. Use for questions like "where is TypeSafe AI headquartered and what does it do", "tell me about Supabase's funding", "what is Ramp valued at" or "who has invested in Ramp". Takes the company's domain or its id from companies/search. Coverage limit: Fireround tracks rounds announced from 2026 onward. It holds a few thousand companies, most of them startups that raised in 2026, and earlier rounds only for some of those. Most companies, and most rounds before 2026, are not on record, so a lookup of an arbitrary company's full funding history, its pre-2026 rounds, an investor's whole portfolio or acquisitions usually returns nothing here; use a company-data provider with historical funding coverage for those.

options.name: id
options.about: The company's domain or its id from companies/search, for example `supabase.com` or `supabase`; its name as written (`Supabase`) works too. Also accepted under company, domain, name or url, including a fireround company URL.

response.about: One company's profile and funding: where it is headquartered, its sector, what it does, its total raised, its valuations, every round and every investor.

Use when you need the evidence and sources behind a company's rounds; for an overview of its funding (total raised, investors) use companies/profile. Coverage limit: Fireround tracks rounds announced from 2026 onward. It holds a few thousand companies, most of them startups that raised in 2026, and earlier rounds only for some of those. Most companies, and most rounds before 2026, are not on record, so a lookup of an arbitrary company's full funding history, its pre-2026 rounds, an investor's whole portfolio or acquisitions usually returns nothing here; use a company-data provider with historical funding coverage for those.

tools.name: Search funding rounds
tools.description: Search startup funding rounds: the latest rounds, the biggest rounds, and rounds by stage, sector, investor, date or size across venture capital (VC funding) of private companies, pre-seed to growth. Who raised money in AI infrastructure this week, who raised a Series A in fintech this week, the largest AI rounds since a date, every round a named fund led or joined. Each funding round carries the company, amount, valuation when stated, lead and other investors, and its sources, so one call answers for many companies' rounds, investors and valuations. Coverage limit: Fireround tracks rounds announced from 2026 onward. It holds a few thousand companies, most of them startups that raised in 2026, and earlier rounds only for some of those. Most companies, and most rounds before 2026, are not on record, so a lookup of an arbitrary company's full funding history, its pre-2026 rounds, an investor's whole portfolio or acquisitions usually returns nothing here; use a company-data provider with historical funding coverage for those.

Use it for questions like "what rounds has Stripe raised and who led each", "how much did Figma raise in its Series B", "who invested in Snowflake's Series A", "total raised by Discord" or "which VCs backed Shopify before its IPO". Takes the company's domain (website), LinkedIn URL or Aviato id. 10 credits per successful call, including an empty page; the price is per call, not per row, so pass perPage=25 to read up to 25 rows at once (omitted, a call returns one row).
